name: openpixo/voxel-3d
title: Voxel 3D
description: Grid-built cubic forms and restrained colors for playful, consistent voxel assets.

description_i18n.en: Grid-built cubic forms and restrained colors for playful, consistent voxel assets.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 以网格搭建的方块形体与精简配色，制作轻快统一的体素素材。

examples.title: Voxel explorer
examples.prompt: Generate an original voxel explorer asset concept using the voxel-3d art style, with a square backpack, green scarf and compact lantern. Keep all parts aligned to the same cubic grid.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 voxel-3d 美术风格生成原创体素探险家资产概念图：方形背包、绿围巾和小灯笼。让所有部件对齐同一个立方体网格。

examples.title: Floating garden island
examples.prompt: Create a small floating garden island concept using the voxel-3d art style, with cubic soil layers, a tiny tree, stepping stones and a water channel. Use one voxel scale across every object.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 voxel-3d 美术风格制作小型漂浮花园岛概念图：立方土层、小树、踏脚石和水渠。所有物体使用统一的体素尺度。

style.prompt: Original voxel 3D game asset concept built entirely from a consistent cubic unit on one axis-aligned grid. Block-stepped silhouettes, flat matte colors from the shared palette and no smooth curved geometry. Use an orthographic three-quarter view, clear top-left light and simple face shading; keep small details at least one full voxel wide.
style.negativePrompt: smooth sculpting, rounded subdivision surfaces, inconsistent voxel sizes, non-cubic blocks, photorealistic texture, glossy plastic, tiny floating fragments, perspective distortion, text, logo, watermark

constraints.outline: Block-stepped cubic edges; one consistent voxel unit.
